title: RELATED crosses a chain of many-to-one relationships
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Sales, "SalesKey", Sales[SalesKey], "Category", RELATED ( Category[Category] ) )

source.quote: RELATED can traverse chains of relationships, as long as they all are in the same many-to-one direction
source.supports: RELATED traverses chains in the many-to-one direction

source.quote: the function follows a chain of one or more many-to-one relationships to fetch the value from the specified column in the related table
source.supports: a chain of one or more many-to-one relationships

derivation: Rows 1, 2: product 100 -> subcategory 10 -> category 1 Bikes. Row 3: 101 -> 10 -> Bikes. Row 4: 102 -> 11 -> Bikes. Rows 5, 6: 103 -> 20 -> category 2 Parts.
